import json, time, urllib.request
detail = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/tasks/detail?task_key=TASK-2").read().decode())
payload = {
    "task_key": "TASK-2",
    "title": detail.get("title", ""),
    "description": detail.get("description", ""),
    "assigned_model": detail.get("assigned_model", "gemini-4-argon (antigravity)"),
    "complexity": detail.get("complexity", "medium"),
    "replan_s1_s3": False,
    "sub_tasks": detail.get("sub_tasks", []),
}
req = urllib.request.Request(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/tasks/update",
    data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
    headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
    method="POST",
)
upd_res = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req).read().decode())
time.sleep(2.5)
tg = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/settings/telegram").read().decode())
print(json.dumps({
    "update_status": upd_res.get("status"),
    "enabled": tg.get("enabled"),
    "has_bot_token": tg.get("has_bot_token"),
    "masked_bot_token": tg.get("masked_bot_token"),
    "chat_id": tg.get("chat_id"),
    "poller_active": tg.get("poller_active"),
    "last_update_id": tg.get("last_update_id"),
    "task_thread_ids": tg.get("task_thread_ids"),
    "recent_events_tail": tg.get("recent_events", [])[-4:],
}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
